punchline: Monks who owned nothing each still kept a little hourglass.
thirty_sec: In Robin Sharma's fable, Julian Mantle is living with sages in the Himalayas when the youngest, Divea, brings him a tiny hourglass. Every sage got one as a child, as a daily reminder that they will die. Her advice: the best time to plant a tree was forty years ago, the second best is today. Julian calls it the deathbed mentality: ask each morning what you'd do if this were your last day.
